direction.name: OFFLINE STUDY: Villa dei Cipressi
direction.concept: A luxurious Mediterranean villa around a sheltered courtyard: a double-height living pavilion crowns the composition, a tall stone entrance hall announces arrival, a two-storey family wing and a lower guest wing complete the U.
hierarchy: Double-height living pavilion as the crown
direction.roofLanguage: Layered terracotta hips: the pavilion highest, the family storey next, the entrance hall and guest wing stepping down.
direction.entrance: A tall limestone entrance hall with a deep portal on the arrival court.
direction.outdoorLiving: A loggia on the courtyard, a pool garden south of the pavilion.

vision.compositionIntent: Family wing, living pavilion and guest wing embrace a courtyard open to the south garden.

signatureFeatures.intent: A two-storey living room under the crowning roof.
A tall stone entrance hall between family wing and pavilion.
A garden court held on three sides.
Roofs stepping down from the pavilion.

blocks.role: Family wing: kitchen, dining and stair below
Upper bedroom storey over the family wing
Low guest wing on the courtyard

openSpaces.role: Courtyard terrace between the guest wing and the loggia
Pool reservation south of the living pavilion

pool.intentResolution: Stage 5 resolves conceptual reservation pool-garden (14×8 m at 11, 10) as one generous 12×4.5 m pool whose full deck envelope is 15.2×8.9 m, centred at 11.0, 11.7; promenade separation clears the accepted house front.

design.statement: OFFLINE STUDY: a generous pool garden south of the pavilion, shade trees around the court.
